{{Otheruses|Thorn}}
A '''thorn tree''' was any one of a number of leafy [[Tree/Legends|trees]] whose stems and branches tended to be thorny. In domestic applications, the thorn tree was employed solely for its aesthetic value.

Around [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], [[Bohhuah Mutdah/Legends|Bohhuah Mutdah]] cultivated thorn trees under his habitation dome on [[Oseon 5792]].
